 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Record of both the Courts below has been received.
Heard on admission.
Revision appears to be arguable is admitted for hearing.
Heard on I.A. No.15599/2025, which is first application under Section 438(1) of BNSS for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of petitioner.

Petitioners has been convicted for the offence under Sections 467, 468, 471 and 420 of IPC and sentenced to suffer 2 years RI with a fine of Rs.500/-, 1 year RI with fine of Rs.200(3 counts) with default stipulation which has been upheld by the appellate Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioners contended that the petitioner has been wrongly convicted by the Trial Court on the basis of improper appreciation of evidence.
There is material contradictions and omissions in the statement of prosecution witness.
There is a strong case in favour of the petitioner.
During trial as well as appellate stage, petitioner remained on bail.
Petitioner has suffered jail incarceration for 5 months and 10 days.
Final conclusion of this revision will take a long time.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence of petitioner till the final disposal of this criminal revision.
Heard both the parties and perused the record.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of the 2 CRR-3385-2025 allegation levelled against the petitioner and also taking note of the fact that the final conclusion of the petitioner will also take sufficiently long time, I deem it proper to suspend the remaining custodial sentence of the petitioner.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, I.A. No.15599/2025 is allowed and it is directed that subject to deposit of fine amount,
if not already deposited, and subject to furnishing personal bond by both the petitioners in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned Trial Court, the execution of remaining custodial part of the sentence of the petitioner shall remain suspended, till final disposal of this petition.
The petitioner after being enlarged on bail shall mark their presence before the Registry of this Court on 18.11.2025 and on all such subsequent dates, which are fixed in this behalf.
List for final hearing in due course along with CRA No.3432/2025.
Certified copy as per rules.
